जोधपुर में इस सप्ताह मौसम साफ रहेगा:दिन का तापमान 38 डिग्री तक पहुंचने की संभावना, गर्मी का असर बढ़ा
- कॉपी लिंक
मौसम विभाग के अनुसार जोधपुर में अगले 6 दिन मौसम साफ रहेगा, वहीं अधिकतम तापमान 38 डिग्री तक पहुंचने की संभावना है। दिन में तापमान में तेजी की वजह से गर्मी का असर बना हुआ है।
दिन में गर्मी का असर बढ़ने से लोगों को परेशानी हो रही है। मौसम विभाग के अनुसार आने वाले दिनों में भी इसका असर बढ़ने की संभावना है। सोमवार को न्यूनतम तापमान में भी 1 डिग्री की बढ़ोतरी दर्ज की गई है।
इधर, न्यूनतम तापमान 23 डिग्री रिकॉर्ड किया गया। आने वाले दिनों में भी न्यूनतम तापमान दो डिग्री तक पहुंचने की संभावना है। तापमान 25 डिग्री तक पहुंच सकता है। 15 और 16 अक्टूबर को न्यूनतम तापमान 25 डिग्री तक बढ़ने की संभावना है।
अभी रहेगा गर्मी का असर, मौसम रहेगा साफ
मौसम विभाग के अनुसार जोधपुर में अगले 6 दिन गर्मी का असर बरकरार रहेगा। 12 और 13 अक्टूबर को अधिकतम तापमान 36 और 14 अक्टूबर को 37 डिग्री पहुंचने की संभावना है।
वहीं 15 से 17 अक्टूबर तक तापमान में दो डिग्री की बढ़ोतरी हो सकती है। ऐसे में तापमान इन दिन दिनों में 38 डिग्री पहुंच सकता है।
चलती कार को आग लगाकर भागने वाले 3 आरोपी गिरफ्तार: वारदात में काम ली क्रेटा भी जब्त, बस रूट विवाद को लेकर किया था हमला

वेस्ट यूपी मौसम: मेरठ में बारिश-ओलावृष्टि, तापमान गिरा; रात में बढ़ी ठंडक, प्रदूषण से राहत की उम्मीद
रविवार को बारिश और ओलावृष्टि के बाद मेरठ में सोमवार को मौसम ठंडा रहा और तापमान में गिरावट दर्ज की गई। रात में हल्की ठंड महसूस होने लगी है। बारिश से प्रदूषण के स्तर में भी राहत मिलने की संभावना है।
विस्तार
मेरठ के मोदीपुरम क्षेत्र में रविवार को हुई बारिश और ओलावृष्टि के बाद सोमवार को मौसम का मिजाज बदल गया। बादलों की आवाजाही और हवा में नमी बढ़ने से तापमान में गिरावट दर्ज की गई। दिन में गर्मी से राहत मिली, जबकि रात में हल्की ठंड महसूस होने लगी है। मौसम वैज्ञानिकों के अनुसार, अगले एक-दो दिन मौसम में उतार-चढ़ाव बना रह सकता है। बारिश के असर से प्रदूषण के स्तर में भी राहत मिलने की उम्मीद है।
बारिश और ओलावृष्टि के बाद तापमान में गिरावट
रविवार को हुई बारिश और ओलावृष्टि का असर सोमवार सुबह से ही दिखाई देने लगा। आसमान में बादलों की आवाजाही और वातावरण में बढ़ी नमी के कारण मौसम अपेक्षाकृत ठंडा रहा। तापमान में गिरावट से लोगों को गर्मी से राहत मिली।

रात में बढ़ने लगी हल्की ठंड
मौसम में बदलाव का असर दिन और रात दोनों के तापमान पर दिखाई दे रहा है। बारिश के बाद सुबह और रात के समय ठंडक महसूस की जा रही है। रात के तापमान में गिरावट के साथ हल्की ठंड का अहसास बढ़ने लगा है।
अगले एक-दो दिन मौसम में रहेगा उतार-चढ़ाव
मौसम वैज्ञानिकों के अनुसार, अगले एक-दो दिन तक मौसम का मिजाज इसी तरह बना रह सकता है। इस दौरान आसमान में बादलों की आवाजाही और तापमान में उतार-चढ़ाव देखने को मिल सकता है।
बारिश से प्रदूषण में राहत की उम्मीद
बारिश से हवा में मौजूद धूल और प्रदूषक कणों को नीचे बैठने में मदद मिलती है। इससे वायु गुणवत्ता में सुधार हो सकता है। हालांकि, मौसम साफ होने और हवा की गति कम रहने पर प्रदूषण का स्तर दोबारा बढ़ सकता है। फिलहाल बारिश के असर से वातावरण में कुछ राहत मिलने की उम्मीद है।

यूपी में इस बार ठिठुरन वाली सर्दी नहीं पड़ेगी:अल नीनो का असर- तापमान 2°C ज्यादा रह सकता है; गर्मी समय से पहले सताएगी
- कॉपी लिंक
अक्टूबर में तेज धूप पसीना छुड़ा रही है। आमतौर पर अक्टूबर में दिन का तापमान 31°C से 33°C रहता है। रात का तापमान 20°C से 22°C के बीच रहता है। महीने की शुरुआत में दिन थोड़े गर्म रहते हैं, लेकिन रातों में हल्की ठंडक महसूस होने लगती है।
लेकिन, इस बार तापमान सामान्य से 1°C से 2°C ऊपर चल रहा है। दिन का तापमान 33°C से 35°C तक और रात का तापमान 22°C से 24°C के आसपास बना हुआ है। कुछ ऐसा ही इन सर्दियों में आपको महसूस होने वाला है।
मौसम वैज्ञानिक प्रशांत महासागर में सक्रिय 'अल नीनो' को इसकी वजह बता रहे हैं। वैज्ञानिकों के अनुसार- अल नीनो का असर फरवरी, 2027 तक बना रहेगा। इस वजह से कड़कडाती ठंड पड़ने के आसार कम हैं। शीतलहर (कोल्ड वेव) का दौर भी बहुत लबां नहीं रहेगा। मार्च, 2027 से ही तापमान तेजी से बढ़ने लगेगा। पढ़िए ये रिपोर्ट…
यूपी जैसे मैदानी इलाकों में शीतलहर अचानक से नहीं आती। इसकी शुरुआत हजारों किलोमीटर दूर भूमध्य सागर से होती है। वहां से उठने वाले चक्रवाती तूफान (पश्चिमी विक्षोभ या वेस्टर्न डिस्टर्बेंस) भारत के पहाड़ी राज्यों (जम्मू-कश्मीर, हिमाचल, उत्तराखंड) तक पहुंचकर बर्फबारी कराते हैं। बर्फबारी से वहां का तापमान माइनस में चला जाता है।
इसके बाद असली खेल शुरू होता है। बर्फबारी रुकने के बाद वहां जमी बर्फ को छूकर बेहद ठंडी और सूखी हवाएं नीचे मैदानी इलाकों की तरफ आती हैं। इन बर्फीली हवाओं को रोकने के लिए रास्ते में कोई पहाड़ या बड़ी रुकावट नहीं है। ये पूरे यूपी को अपनी चपेट में ले लेती हैं।
कैसे अल नीनो ठंडी हवाओं में रुकावट बनेगा
कोहरा उतना घना नहीं होगा, ‘कोल्ड डे’ भी कम होंगे
सर्दियों में दिसंबर-जनवरी के 10 से 15 दिन ऐसे होते हैं, जब पूरे दिन धूप नहीं निकलती। सुबह और रात में घना कोहरा छाता है। सर्द हवाएं दिनभर ठिठुरन महसूस करवाती हैं। जब दिन का तापमान 10डिग्री से कम बना रहता है, तब मौसम विभाग इसको ‘कोल्ड डे’ यानी ठंडा दिन मानता है।
मौसम विभाग का पूर्वांनुमान है कि इस बार सर्दियों में ‘कोल्ड डे’ के दिन कम रह सकते हैं। स्काईमेट वेदर के वरिष्ठ मौसम वैज्ञानिक महेश पलावत बताते हैं- घने कोहरे की वजह से धूप जमीन तक कम पहुंच पाती। इस वजह से दिन में भी तापमान बेहद कम रहता है।
कैसे अल नीनो कोहरा नहीं बनने देगा
अल नीनो के असर से सर्दियों का तापमान सामान्य से 1-2 डिग्री सेल्सियस ज्यादा रह सकता है। जबकि, घने कोहरे के लिए हवा में नमी और कम तापमान जरूरी है। घना कोहरा नहीं बनने से आसमान साफ रहेगा। सीधी धूप जमीन तक पहुंचेगी और कड़ाके की ठंड नहीं पड़ेगी।
मार्च के आखिरी 15 दिन में तेजी से बढ़ेगा तापमान
यूं तो मार्च महीने के आखिर तक गर्मी की शुरुआत मानी जाती है। मार्च में धीरे-धीरे तापमान बढ़ता है, लेकिन दिन का तापमान 32-35 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक बना रहता है। प्रशांत महासागर में सक्रिय अल नीनो का असर फरवरी-मार्च, 2027 तक बना रहेगा। इसकी वजह से मार्च के आखिरी 15 दिनों में तापमान तेजी से बढ़ने की आशंका जताई जा रही है।
ठंड कम पड़ने से गेहूं-सरसो की फसल पर असर पड़ेगा
यूपी देश का सबसे बड़ा गेहूं उत्पादक राज्य है। फरवरी-मार्च में गेहूं की फसल के दाना भरने और पकने के लिए ठंडे मौसम की जरूरत होती है। अगर सर्दियों में तापमान 1 से 2 डिग्री भी ऊपर रहता है, तो गेहूं का विकास चक्र छोटा हो जाएगा। मिट्टी में नमी की कमी और समय से पहले गर्मी बढ़ने के कारण फसलों के समय से पहले पकने का खतरा है। इससे दाने पतले रह सकते हैं और पैदावार घट सकती है।
फसल बचाने के लिए ये तरीके अपनाए जा सकते हैं…
नमी बचाना सबसे जरूरी: बांदा कृषि एवं प्रौद्यौगिकी विश्वविद्यालय में कृषि विभाग के प्रोफेसर डॉ. दिनेश शाह बताते हैं- अल नीनो से खेतों में सूखापन जल्दी आ सकता है। इसलिए खेत की बार-बार जुताई के बजाय रोटावेटर या हैरो से हल्की जुताई करके, तुरंत पाटा (प्लैंक) लगाएं। जिससे नमी अंदर लॉक हो जाए और फिर बुआई कर दें। इससे मिट्टी की नमी बची रहेगी। सिंचाई के लिए फव्वारा (स्प्रिंकलर) या टपक (ड्रिप) तकनीक का इस्तेमाल करें, जिससे पानी की बचत हो सके।
घास-फूस पर तुरंत काबू: सूखे और कम पानी के मौसम में खरपतवार (घास-फूस) फसल का सारा पानी और खाद खुद सोख लेते हैं। इसलिए निराई-गुड़ाई समय पर करते रहें। मिट्टी की जांच के हिसाब से ही संतुलित खाद का उपयोग करें।

Mumbai recorded a maximum temperature of 35.6 degrees Celsius on Saturday as hot and humid conditions continued across the city and suburbs, while the India Meteorological Department (IMD) maintained a heatwave warning for parts of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and Maharashtra’s Konkan belt until October 12.
The IMD has forecast mainly clear skies over Mumbai and surrounding areas on Sunday, with the maximum temperature expected to remain around 36 degrees Celsius and the minimum near 22 degrees Celsius. No rainfall was recorded in Mumbai or its suburbs during the day, and the combination of heat and humidity added to residents’ discomfort.
Data from the IMD’s Regional Meteorological Centre showed that the Colaba and Santacruz weather stations each recorded a maximum temperature of 35.6 degrees Celsius. Santacruz recorded a minimum temperature of 27.5 degrees Celsius. At Colaba, relative humidity was 80 per cent at 8.30 am before falling to 48 per cent by 5.30 pm.
The Regional Meteorological Centre said heatwave conditions were likely at isolated places in districts of South Konkan, while hot and humid weather was expected at isolated locations in North Konkan. The warning comes as maximum temperatures are forecast to rise gradually by 2 to 3 degrees Celsius in some parts of Maharashtra.
Several other parts of the state also recorded elevated temperatures. Malegaon recorded Maharashtra’s highest maximum temperature at 38.4 degrees Celsius, while Jalgaon recorded the lowest minimum temperature at 18.2 degrees Celsius.
The IMD forecast indicates that warm and humid conditions are likely to continue across the coastal region through the weekend. Residents may experience greater discomfort during the afternoon, when high temperatures combine with humidity. The warning remains in force until October 12, according to the Regional Meteorological Centre in Mumbai.

Bugatti has swapped snowy conditions for scorching heat in the latest episode of its A New Era documentary series. This time, the Tourbillon prototype headed to Seville, Spain, where temperatures crossed 45°C (113°F) as engineers put its cooling systems to the test.
The team fitted the hypercar with more than 200 thermocouples to monitor temperatures across different areas. The aim was to keep the powertrain and cabin cool without compromising the Tourbillon’s striking design.
Daniel Ríos Hidalgo, a vehicle development engineer at Bugatti Rimac, explained that clever cooling circuits help control temperatures while preserving the car’s shape.
Testing covered both public roads and a racetrack, with each presenting different challenges. Road driving simulated the heat owners might encounter in warmer climates, while track sessions placed sustained demands on the tyres, brakes, powertrain and cooling systems.

Xadgudub galmo oo loo geystay dad naafo ah, oo gilgilay Koonfurta Kuuriya
"Gudaha ayaan ka dhibtoonayay, waana sababta aan u imid inaan sheekadayda u sheego dadka."
Kuwani waxay ahaayeen ereyadii ugu horreeyay ee Soo Mi-hyun ay u sheegto booliiska.
Sue, oo qabta naafonimo dhanka garashada ah, ayaa dhibaato kala kulanta dhisidda jumlado dhaadheer, waxayna ku hadli kartaa oo kaliya ereyo gaagaaban iyo tilmaamo. Hase yeeshee, xusuusta xadgudubkii loo geystay ayaa weli si cad ugu jirta maskaxdeeda.
Waxay ka mid ahayd saddex qof oo ku noolaa xarun daryeel oo ay dowladdu maamusho oo ku taal Koonfurta Kuuriya, kuwaas oo uu xadgudub galmo kula kacay agaasimihii xarunta. Kiiskan ayaa gilgilay Koonfurta Kuuriya, wuxuuna dhaliyay su'aalo culus oo ku saabsan xarumaha dowladda ee dadka qaba naafonimada.
Horraantii bishan, maxkamad ku taal Seoul ayaa agaasimihii xarunta, oo magaciisa dambe lagu sheegay Kim, ku xukuntay 15 sano oo xarig ah. Kim ayaa racfaan ka qaatay xukunkaas.
Maxkamadda ayaa go'aankan gaartay ku dhawaad laba sano ka dib markii Sue, oo da'deedu ay tahay afartameeyo, ay markii ugu horreysay hooyadeed u sheegtay xadgudubka loo geystay.
Si loo ilaaliyo aqoonsigooda, waxaan warbixintan beddelnay magacyada Sue iyo dhibbane kale.
"Kaliya waan iska dulqaadanayay"
Sannadkii 2016-kii, Su waxay bilowday inay ku noolaato Saekdongwon, oo ah xarun daryeel oo loogu talagalay dadka qaba naafanimada dhanka garaadka.
Xaruntan oo ku taal magaalada Incheon ayaa dhammaan dhaqaalaheeda ka hesha dowladda, waxayna weli hoy u tahay qiyaastii 33 qof, inkastoo mas'uuliyiinteeda laga codsaday inay xiraan xarunta ka dib dhacdadan.
Sida ay sheegtay Su, xadgudubku wuxuu billowday wax yar ka dib markii ay bilowday inay xarunta ku noolaato. Kim ayaa u iman jiray habeenkii ama saacadaha hore ee subaxdii, wuxuuna ku sameyn jiray kufsi.
Su, iyadoo adeegsanaysa qareenkeeda Ko Eun-young, waxay sheegtay inaysan xarunta ku jirin qof weyn oo ay kala hadli karto xadgudubkaas. Waxay intaas ku dartay inay dareemaysay in shaqaalaha kale aysan iyadana caawin doonin. Maamulka xarunta ayaan ka jawaabin eedeyntaas.
Nolosheedu waxay sidan ku sii socotay muddo ku dhow 10 sano ilaa sheekadu ay soo shaac baxday bishii Febraayo 2025-kii, ka dib markii Su ay dhaawac madaxa ah soo gaaray.
Waxay sheegtay in dhacdadu ay dhacday markii Kim uu isku dayay inuu mar kale xadgudub galmo kula kaco. Su ayaa gacmaheeda ku celisay, Kim-na wuxuu uga jawaabay inuu galaas ku tuuro.
Qareenka Su ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in shaqaalaha xaruntu ay geeyeen isbitaalka, ayna hooyadeed u sheegeen dhacdada kaliya ka dib markii la tolay dhaawaca madaxeeda.
Sida uu sheegay qareenka Su, hooyadeed waxay codsatay inay aragto muuqaallada CCTV-ga si ay u ogaato sida gabadheeda ay ku dhaawacantay, balse mas'uuliyiinta xarunta ayaa diiday codsigaas, iyagoo sheegay inaan loo ogolayn inay bixiyaan muuqaalladaas.
Sidaas darteed, hooyadeed ayaa guriga geysay waxayna go'aansatay inaysan xarunta ku sii hayn. Kaliya markii loo sheegay Su inaysan u baahnayn inay dib ugu laabato xarunta ayay hooyadeed u sheegtay xadgudubka galmada, taas oo iyaduna arrinta u gudbisay booliiska.
"Markii ay ii sheegeen inaanan u baahnayn inaan dib ugu laabto Saekdongwon, waxaan u maleeyay inaan si kalsooni leh u hadli karo," ayay Su u sheegtay BBC-da iyadoo adeegsanaysa qareenkeeda.
Markii la weydiiyay sida ay ugu suurtagashay inay kaligeed la tacaasho xaaladdan sannadahan oo dhan, waxay tiri, "Waan u adkaystay."
Xaruntan ayaa ku taallay magaalada Incheon ee Koonfurta Kuuriya.
Kadib, booliisku waxay baaritaanka ku saabsan hadallada Su u ballaariyeen dadka kale ee xarunta ku nool.
Saraakiishu waxay aqoonsadeen ugu yaraan laba qof oo kale oo laga yaabo inay dhibanayaal ahaayeen; mid ka mid ah ayaa ahayd Lee Mina, taas oo sheegtay in Kim uu iyadana kufsaday xilli ay fadhiday musqusha.
Horraantii bishan, garsoore qaadayay kiiska ayaa caddeeyey in markhaatifurka saddexda dhibaneba uu yahay mid la isku hallayn karo.
Maxkamaddu waxay Kim ku xukuntay 15 sano oo xabsi ah kiisaska kufsigii Lee iyo Su; xukunkan ayaa shan sano ka yar kii ay markii hore codsadeen xeer-ilaaliyeyaashu. Kim ayaa beeniyay dhammaan eedeymaha, wuxuuna racfaan ka qaatay xukunka.
Marka la eego dhibanaha saddexaad, maxkamaddu waxay Kim ku heshay dambi ah fal galmo oo ka fudud kufsiga. Garsooruhu wuxuu sheegay in eedeynta kufsiga la laalay maadaama aysan maxkamaddu helin caddeyn buuxda oo muujinaysa in "xoog ama hanjabaad loo adeegsaday qaab aanu dhibanuhu awood ugu lahayn inuu iska caabiyo."
Guddi wadajir ah oo ka kooban kooxaha u dooda xuquuqda dadka naafada ah iyo ururro kale oo bulshada rayidka ah ayaa dhaliilay xukunka, iyagoo sheegaya in awoodda dhibanuhu u leeyahay inuu iska caabiyo weerarka aysan ahayn inay saameyn ku yeelato xukunka la riday.
Guddigu waxay sidoo kale dhaliileen habka baaritaanka, iyagoo sheegay in mas'uuliyiintu ay ku guuldareysteen inay aqoonsadaan dad kale oo laga yaabo inay dhibanayaal ahaayeen.
Bishii Nofembar 2025, kadib markii ugu horreysay la soo saaray eedeymaha ku saabsan xadgudubka, mas'uuliyiinta deegaanka ee Degmada Ganghwa ayaa u xilsaaray koox ka socota Jaamacadda Woosuk inay si dhow u baaraan xaaladda dadka ku nool xarunta Saekdongwon.
Warbixinta kooxda, oo maxkamadda loo soo bandhigay caddeyn ahaan, ayaa tilmaamaysa in tiro aad uga badan dadka deegaanka—ugu yaraan 10 qof—ay laga yaabo inay ahaayeen dhibanayaal falal galmo oo xadgudub ah oo uu geystay Kim.
Hase yeeshee, maxkamaddu kama aysan hadlin natiijadan intii uu socday kiisku.
Sida ay sheegeen warbaahinta maxalliga ah, booliisku waxay dhibaato kala kulmeen wareysiga dadka deegaanka si loo ogaado faahfaahinta xadgudubka la sheegay, maadaama badankoodu ay qabeen naafonimo daran, ayna ku adkeyd inay is-gaarsiiyaan. Waxaa la sheegay in dadka qaar ay su'aalaha ku jawaabayeen wax aan khuseyn ama aysan gabi ahaanba ka jawaabin.
Kiiskan kadib, waxaa la codsaday in la xiro xarunta Saekdongwon.
Kim kama uusan jawaabin eedaha ah inuu dhibaateeyay dad badan oo deganaa xarunta.
Jun Ji-soo, oo ah bare sare oo hogaaminayay kooxda cilmi-baarista ee Jaamacadda Woosuk, ayaa u sheegay BBC in baarayaashu "ay aqbaleen oo keliya hadallada dadka ku tilmaami kara xadgudubka jumlado dhammaystiran."
Laakiin dhaqdhaqaaqayaashu waxay sheegeen in ku tiirsanaanta markhaati furka oo keliya ay keentay in booliisku ay ku guuldareystaan inay aqoonsadaan inay yihiin dadka deegaanka ee dhibanayaasha ah ee ay ku adkaatay inay isgaarsiiyaan.
"Haddii dhibanayaashu ay ku muujiyaan waayo-aragnimadooda si ka duwan sida aan fileyno, miyaanay ahayn in dawladdu ay dadaal badan ku bixiso sidii ay u maqli lahayd codkooda?" ayuu yiri Baek In-seong, oo ka tirsan Xarunta La-talinta Han Sahoe ee Dadka Ka Badbaaday Xadgudubka Galmada ee Naafada ah.
"In kasta oo ay jiri karaan cillado kiisas gaar ah, haddana waa in aan loo gudbin habka baaritaanka oo dhan," ayay booliisku sheegeen.
Ururada xuquuqda naafada ayaa sidoo kale dhaleeceeyay kuwa ku baaqaya in xukunka Kim la dhimo.
Wadarta guud ee 13 codsi oo ku saabsan dabacsanaan ayaa la sheegay in loo gudbiyay maxkamadda ka hor inta aan xukunka la ridin. Mid ka mid ah codsiyadan waxaa soo gudbiyay hay'ad samafal bulsho, iyagoo weydiisanaya maxkamadda inay tixgeliso "adeegyada eedaysanaha ee qaybta samafalka."
Kooxda u doodda daryeelka bulshada ee Gaelic ayaa cambaareysay ururada soo gudbiyay codsiyada noocaas ah, iyagoo leh, "Adeeggii hore ee waaxda daryeelka bulshada kama dhaafayo qofna isla xisaabtanka."
Markii uu xukunka ku riday Kim, garsooruhu wuxuu sheegay in dambigiisu "uu si gaar ah u canaanan karo" sababtoo ah "inkastoo uu waajibkiisa xirfadeed uu yahay inuu ilaaliyo xuquuqda iyo danaha dhibanayaasha, inuu taageero iyo inuu ka hortago xadgudubka," wuxuu ka faa'iidaystay isku dheelitir la'aanta awoodda ee u dhaxaysa isaga iyo dhibanayaasha si uu "u qanciyo rabitaankiisa galmada."
Falcelinta dadweynaha iyo mudaaharaadyada
Kiiska ayaa naxdin ku riday dad badan oo Kuuriyada Koonfureed ah, waxaana su'aalo laga keenay sababta xadgudubka aan markii hore loo joojin. Waxa ka sii yaab badan ayaa ah in ay dhacday inkastoo tallaabooyin la qaaday 2011 si loo xoojiyo sharciyada ka ilaalinaya dadka naafada ah weerarrada galmada.
Isla sanadkaas, filimka "Double" ayaa la sii daayay, iyadoo lagu saleynayo sheeko dhab ah oo ku saabsan xadgudubka galmada ee dugsi loogu talagalay carruurta dhegoolaha ah. Ka dib dibadbaxyo xooggan, dugsiga waa la xiray, waxaana la sameeyay xeerar adag.
Sharciyadan waxaa ka mid ahaa qeexidda qaybaha gaarka ah ee dambiyada galmada ee ka dhanka ah dadka naafada ah, ciqaabo adag oo loogu talagalay dambiyada ay geystaan maamulayaasha iyo shaqaalaha xarunta daryeelka, iyo in la qaado sharciga xaddidaadda dambiyada galmada qaarkood ee ka dhanka ah dhibanayaasha naafada ah.
Laakiin kiiska Saekdongwon, xadgudubyadu way sii socdeen inkastoo kormeer joogto ah ay sameeyeen Degmada Ganghwa, oo ah hay'adda maxalliga ah ee mas'uulka ka ah kormeerka xarunta.
Sarkaal ka tirsan degmada ayaa u sheegay BBC in kormeerayaashu ay inta badan diiradda saareen dib u eegista dukumentiyada oo ay la hadleen dadka deegaanka oo keliya marka ay timaado dhibaato gaar ah.
Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in sidoo kale ay jirtay koox kormeer oo dibadda ah, laakiin aysan helin wax warbixin ah oo ka timid shaqaalaha. Wuxuu ka xun yahay in mas'uuliyiintu aysan si taxaddar leh u eegin xaaladda.
Dadka deegaanka qaarkood waxay lahaayeen naafonimo daran wayna ku adkaatay inay la xiriiraan.
Joo Ha, oo ah wakiil ka socda Golaha Qaranka ee La-talinta Xarumaha — hay'ad taageertay qaar ka mid ah dhibbanayaasha xarunta Saekdongwon — ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah qoysaskii uu la hadlay ay ka shakiyeen in xadgudub dhacayo, balse ay dareemeen inaysan awoodin inay cabbiraan walaacooda.
In qof laga soo saaro xarunta waxay ka dhigan tahay in qoysku ay qaadaan dhammaan mas'uuliyadda daryeelka, maadaama ay adag tahay in la helo xarun kale oo beddel u noqota.
Sahan ay sameysay Ururka Qaranka ee Waalidiinta Dadka ku jira Xarumaha Daryeelka ee Dadka Naafada ah ayaa lagu ogaaday in ku dhawaad lix ka mid ah 10-kii qof ee helay fursad ay ku galaan xarun daryeel ay sugayeen ugu yaraan saddex sano; arrintan ayaa muujinaysa sida ay u adag tahay helitaanka daryeel ku habboon.
Professor Kim Yeon-tae, oo ah madaxa Machadka Sayniska Garashada ee Jaamacadda Woosuk, ayaa xusay in xarumahan oo kale ay si weyn u maamulaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada dadka ku jira, laga bilaabo waxa ay cunayaan iyo halka ay seexanayaan ilaa helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka iyo xitaa in loo oggol yahay inay ka baxaan xarunta iyo in kale.
Jo ayaa intaas ku daray in inkasta oo kiiska Saek Dong-won loo arko "kiis muhiim ah oo tusaale u ah kiisaska kale" sababo la xiriira baaxadda iyo muddada uu socday xadgudubku, haddana uusan ahayn dhacdo gaar ah ama mid aan hore loo arag.
Sanadkii 2023-kii, maxkamadda racfaanka ayaa ansixisay xukun xabsi oo siddeed sano ah oo lagu riday shaqaale ka tirsan xarun lagu hayo dadka oo ku taal Yongcheon; qofkaas ayaa sannadkii ka horreeyay kufsaday ama si xun u galmooday laba haween ah oo qaba naafonimo dhanka maskaxda ah.
Kiis kale oo ka dhacay Anseong, maxkamad ayaa dhawaan shaqaale ka tirsan xarun daryeel ku xukuntay lix sano oo xabsi ah ka dib markii uu si joogto ah u kufsaday haweenay naafo ah oo ku jirtay xaruntaas sannadkii 2022-kii.
"Rabshadaha ay la kulmaan haweenka naafada ah ma aha dhibaato shakhsiyeed," ayuu yiri Jo. "Waa rabshad nidaamsan oo ay sababeen arrimo is-biirsaday oo kala ah jinsiga, naafonimada, ku noolaanshaha xarumaha daryeelka, saboolnimada iyo go'doonka bulshada."
"Waxaan rabnaa inaan nabad ku noolaanno"
Tan iyo markii arrintan la ogaaday, Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Koonfurta Kuuriya ayaa amar ku bixiyay in la sameeyo koox ka jawaabta xaaladda oo ka kooban hay'ado dawladeed oo kala duwan, isagoo ku tilmaamay dhacdada "arrin aad u culus oo shaki gelinaysa mabda'a aasaasiga ah ee jiritaanka dawladda."
Bishii Abriil 2026, dawladdu waxay ku dhawaaqday inay kormeertay 1,507 xarumood oo dadka naafada ah lagu xanaaneeyo oo ku yaalla dalka oo dhan, isla markaana ay heshay 33 kiis oo laga shakisan yahay inay yihiin xadgudubyo. Ilaa hadda, waxaa la bilaabay baaritaanno ku saabsan siddeed ka mid ah kiisaskaas.
Dawladdu waxay sidoo kale ku dhawaaqday inay xoojin doonto kormeerka gaarka ah ee ku salaysan heerka khatarta, iyo sidoo kale kormeerka wadajirka ah ee ay ka qaybqaadanayaan maamulka deegaanka, booliiska, iyo ururada u dooda xuquuqda dadka naafada ah.
Degmada Ganghwa ayaa amar ku bixisay in la xiro xarunta Saekdongwon, maamulka deegaankuna wuxuu laalay shatigii hay'adda maamusha xaruntaas.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xiritaanka xarunta ayaa dib loo dhigay ilaa laga wareejinayo dadka weli halkaas ku nool, lana dhammaystirayo qorshayaasha noloshooda madax-bannaan.
Maamulka deegaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay diyaarin doonaan qorshe taageero oo gaar ah oo ku saabsan nolol madax-bannaan oo loogu talagalay mid kasta oo ka mid ah 33-ka qof ee ku nool Saekdongwon. Hannaankan ayaa weli socda.
Saekdongwon ayaa gudbisay cabasho maamul si ay uga hortagto tallaabada lagu laalay shatigeeda. Xaruntu weli kama aysan hadlin xukunka lagu riday Kim.
Markii la weydiiyay isbeddelka ugu weyn ee nolosheeda ku yimid tan iyo markii uu ka tagtay Saekdongwon, Soo waxay tiri, "Waxaan dareemayaa xasillooni. Maalin kasta waan faraxsanahay."
Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in qaybta ugu wanaagsan ee nolosheeda cusub ay tahay inay cuni karto oo seexan karto wakhtiga ay doonto.
Rabitaankeeda ugu weyn hadda wuxuu ahaa inay "gabi ahaanba joojiso xiriirka ay la leedahay agaasimaha xarunta, isla markaana uusan waligiis wax shaqo ah ku yeelan iyada mar dambe."
Laakiin Soo waxay intaas ku dartay in dadka naafada ah ay weli u baahan yihiin meel ay ku dareemi karaan ammaan.
"Waxaan rajeynayaa inay jirto xarun aan laga geysan xadgudubyo galmo, isla markaana ay dadka naafada ah ee nala midka ah ku noolaan karaan nabad."

full_text:
Copper is famous for carrying electricity and heat, but it has always had a fatal weakness at elevated temperatures: it softens, its microstructure degrades, and it oxidizes rapidly when the mercury climbs. A team of researchers led by Yuan Li, Haibo Shi, Zhumin Li and colleagues at Anhui Polytechnic University, working with collaborators at Dalian University of Technology, Anhui Polytechnic University and Lanzhou University of Technology, has now systematically mapped how a new class of copper-based multi-component alloys behaves under exactly those punishing conditions. Their study, published in the Journal of Materials Science, combines multiscale experimental characterization with first-principles calculations and thermodynamic modeling to answer two questions that determine whether these materials can ever leave the laboratory: does the strengthening structure survive long-term heat exposure, and can the alloy protect itself against oxygen attack at temperatures approaching 1000 degrees Celsius?
The material at the heart of the study belongs to a family known as multi-principal-element alloys, sometimes called complex concentrated alloys. Unlike conventional alloys, which are built around one dominant metal with small additions of others, these systems mix several principal elements in significant proportions. The copper-based variant examined here gains its remarkable strength from a dense dispersion of nanoscale precipitates with the L1₂ crystal structure, the same ordered phase that gives nickel-based superalloys their legendary ability to hold shape inside jet engines. These coherent precipitates share a continuous crystal lattice with the surrounding copper matrix, which means they block dislocations, the tiny defects responsible for plastic deformation, with exceptional efficiency while adding very little resistance to the flow of electrons. That combination of strength and conductivity is precisely what engineers crave for high-heat-flux applications such as combustion chamber liners, fusion reactor components and advanced power electronics.
Strength at room temperature, however, is only half the story. Any candidate material for such duties must also keep that strength after hundreds or thousands of hours at operating temperature, because the nanoscale precipitates that provide strengthening are thermodynamically driven to coarsen. The classic Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner theory of Ostwald ripening describes how larger particles grow at the expense of smaller ones, reducing the total interfacial area and therefore the strengthening effect. The research team exposed their alloy to temperatures between 650 and 750 degrees Celsius, a range directly relevant to many industrial service environments, and tracked the evolution of the precipitated phases over prolonged thermal exposure. The results were strikingly encouraging: the multi-component L1₂ phase exhibited excellent thermal stability throughout this window, with only a slow coarsening process. The sluggish diffusion of the multiple alloying elements, a hallmark of chemically complex alloys, appears to be the key, as it throttles the atomic transport needed for precipitates to grow.
The authors did not stop at the bulk microstructure, and this is where the study delivers one of its most important cautionary findings. While the precipitates inside the grains remained fine and stable, the particles sitting on grain boundaries followed a different and more destructive path. During prolonged thermal exposure, these grain boundary precipitates underwent discontinuous coarsening, a mechanism in which a moving boundary sweeps behind it a coarse, lamellar colony of precipitates, effectively consuming the fine strengthening structure in its wake. Discontinuous coarsening is a well-known degradation route in superalloys and other precipitation-strengthened systems, and its presence here signals that the alloy’s properties could deteriorate in localized regions even when the grain interiors look pristine. The researchers are candid about the implication: further optimization and precise regulation of the alloy system remain imperative for future research, particularly in controlling what happens at grain boundaries during long service lives.
To understand why the bulk L1₂ phase is so resistant to coarsening, the team turned to computation as well as experiment. First-principles calculations, which solve the quantum mechanical equations governing electron behavior in the crystal, together with thermodynamic calculations, allowed the researchers to probe the energetic and kinetic factors stabilizing the multicomponent precipitates. In chemically complex alloys, each alloying element diffuses at a different rate through the crowded, distorted lattice, and strong interactions between elements can further slow atomic transport. This sluggish diffusion, documented in related high-entropy and complex concentrated systems, raises the activation barrier for the coarsening process and helps explain the slow kinetics observed between 650 and 750 degrees Celsius. The combination of atomistic modeling and microstructural observation gives the study a level of mechanistic depth that pure microscopy alone could not achieve, and it provides a quantitative framework that other alloy designers can reuse.
The second half of the study confronts the oxidation problem, and here the news is genuinely exciting. When metals react with oxygen at high temperature, they form oxide scales whose quality determines whether the metal underneath survives. Poor scales are porous, cracked or fast-growing; good scales are dense, adherent and slow-growing. The researchers oxidized their alloy at temperatures from 850 to 990 degrees Celsius, an aggressive regime well above the service range of most conventional copper alloys, and measured how the oxide grew over time. The oxidation kinetics generally conformed to a parabolic law, meaning the oxide thickness grows with the square root of time. Parabolic behavior is the signature of a protective scale, because it indicates that further oxidation is controlled by the slow diffusion of ions through an intact barrier layer rather than by rapid reactions at the surface. For a copper-based alloy, sustaining parabolic kinetics at nearly 1000 degrees Celsius is a remarkable result.
The secret lies in the architecture of the oxide film itself. Rather than a single homogeneous layer, the alloy builds a sophisticated multilayered structure on its surface. At the base sits a continuous layer of aluminum oxide, Al₂O₃, one of the most effective diffusion barriers known in high-temperature metallurgy. Above it forms a multi-component spinel phase, a class of mixed-metal oxides with a robust cubic structure, and on the very outside accumulate complex oxides containing the more reactive alloying elements. The critical synergy identified by the authors is between the continuous aluminum-rich oxide layer and the multi-component spinel layer: together they inhibit the diffusion of both oxygen inward and metal ions outward. Because oxidation requires counter-flowing fluxes of these species, choking both directions simultaneously slows the reaction dramatically. The spinel acts as a chemically complex middle wall whose sluggish transport properties complement the near-impermeable alumina beneath it.
This protective architecture does not appear by accident. It emerges through selective oxidation, the thermodynamic sorting process by which the most oxygen-hungry elements in an alloy, here aluminum and chromium, are preferentially drawn to the surface and oxidized first, while less reactive elements such as copper are left behind. The same design philosophy underlies the oxidation resistance of stainless steels and nickel superalloys, which rely on chromium and aluminum to build their own armor. What makes the new work notable is that the authors demonstrate this principle working in a copper-dominant multi-component system, where copper’s own oxides would normally dominate and grow rapidly. By formulating the alloy so that aluminum and chromium are available in sufficient quantity to establish continuous protective layers, the researchers effectively taught a copper alloy to behave like a superalloy in the furnace.
The broader significance of the study is that it closes a systematic knowledge gap. Earlier work by some of the same groups had shown that compositionally complex, coherently strengthened copper alloys can deliver outstanding mechanical properties across a wide temperature range, and that the composition of the gamma-prime-like (Ni, Cu)₃Al phase evolves linearly with alloy chemistry. But without data on thermal stability and oxidation, engineers had no way to assess whether such alloys could survive real service environments. The new results provide that assessment in two parts: a positive verdict on the bulk precipitate stability up to 750 degrees Celsius, tempered by the grain boundary caveat, and a strong endorsement of the oxidation resistance up to 990 degrees Celsius, grounded in a clear mechanistic picture of the layered scale.
There is also a methodological lesson for the field. By pairing multiscale characterization with first-principles and thermodynamic calculations, the team showed how modern alloy development can proceed: computational screening identifies the stabilizing factors and predicts phase behavior, while targeted experiments validate the predictions and reveal failure modes, such as discontinuous coarsening, that models alone can miss. As demands intensify from aerospace, nuclear and energy sectors for conductors that can take the heat, copper-based multi-principal-element alloys strengthened by stable L1₂ precipitates and armored by self-forming oxide multilayers are emerging as a serious contender. The remaining engineering challenge, taming the grain boundaries, is now clearly defined, and the path toward alloys that are simultaneously strong, conductive and oxidation-proof at extreme temperatures has become substantially clearer.

SIP inflows hit all-time high of ₹32,490 crore in September
Monthly SIP contributions to mutual funds reached a record ₹32,490 crore in September, while net equity mutual fund inflows surged 30.6% month-on-month to ₹38,293.5 crore, driven by strong investments in small-cap, mid-cap, and equity ETF schemes.
Monthly contributions through systematic investment plans (SIPs) into mutual funds touched a record high of ₹32,490 crore in September, up 0.6% from ₹32,297 crore in August, according to data from the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI).
SIP contributions have remained above ₹32,000 crore for the second consecutive month, with September setting a new record.
SIPs allow investors to contribute a fixed amount to mutual fund schemes at regular intervals, usually monthly, rather than invest a lump sum at one time.
Manish Mehta, Chief Business Officer at SBI Mutual Fund, said SIP numbers were largely flat month-on-month, but investor confidence in using SIPs to navigate market volatility was encouraging.
Nirav Karkera, Head of Research and Fund Manager at W by Groww, said the record SIP inflows could reflect both fresh investments and investors switching the mutual fund schemes through which they invest via SIPs.
He said SIP inflows should also be viewed alongside SIP stoppages to understand the trend better.
The September data also showed net inflows into equity mutual fund schemes rising 30.6% month-on-month to ₹38,293.5 crore from ₹29,315 crore in August. Small-cap funds attracted ₹9,039 crore, their highest-ever monthly inflow, while mid-cap funds saw inflows of ₹7,835 crore.
In terms of assets under management (AUM), mid-cap funds had ₹5.14 lakh crore at the end of September, followed by small-cap funds at ₹4.16 lakh crore. Both categories had a higher AUM than large-cap funds, which stood at ₹3.9 lakh crore.
Karkera said strong inflows into small- and mid-cap funds indicated continued investor interest in these segments despite volatility. He added that interest in large-cap funds was also returning, citing their relatively wider margin of safety and investor interest in sectors such as financial services.
Equity exchange-traded funds (ETFs) attracted ₹9,960 crore during September, while gold and silver ETFs saw inflows of ₹4,451 crore and ₹1,974 crore, respectively.
The mutual fund industry's total assets under management stood at ₹82.64 lakh crore at the end of September, compared with ₹87.07 lakh crore in August.

The weather conditions brought temporary relief from the recent warmth, with thick clouds covering the city during the early morning hours. However, the downpour also raised concerns about traffic congestion, waterlogging and possible disruptions to daily commuting.

The red alert signals the need for heightened caution as severe weather conditions affect the city. The IMD has warned that heavy showers could lead to water accumulation in low-lying areas, slow-moving traffic and an increased risk of road accidents.
Commuters have been advised to check traffic updates before setting out, follow official weather and traffic advisories, and avoid routes that are particularly vulnerable to waterlogging.
Residents have also been urged to exercise caution during thunderstorms, especially while travelling outdoors. Strong winds, lightning and slippery roads could create hazardous conditions during the morning rush hour.
The rainfall comes after Delhi recorded a decline in temperatures over the preceding 24 hours. According to the weather department, maximum temperatures dropped by around one to two degrees Celsius, while minimum temperatures remained largely unchanged.
